unclear_items: As-built sheets are outlined vector text; all values read visually - weights per part NOT stated anywhere.
Support ring dims inconsistent (PCD2912 < ID3012; OD3512 vs shell OD 2812) - could not confirm geometry.
Nozzle P (3in) appears in load table, plan view and shell layout but not in the nozzle list and has no detail sheet.
L1/L2 are 3in in list/details but connected pipe 2in SCH40 in load table (DN50).
Nozzle projections / elevations: dimension chain on sheet 1 does not close; detail sheets give figures ('1660 TO TL', '950 TO CL', '1560 TO CL') whose reference lines are ambiguous - not extracted.
Drawn/checked/approved initials; revision table blank; scale '-'.
Customer drawing: design-pressure/temperature digits, parts-list rows 101-109, SS41 vs SF41 handwriting, sizes of D/E/L nozzles in table are low-contrast.
'Stub end' is not named on as-built; inferred from LJF + COLLARING + Gr.7 lining. Loose-flange standard/material is SS400 not A105.
No nozzle schedule schedule/sch column on as-built; sch only in part lists for small pipe necks.
